conceptHistory.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create a polished new Vietnamese mobile game HOW TO PLAY modal for Cờ Tỷ Phú.
Reference roles: IMAGE 1 is the authoritative lobby/background, portrait composition, VIP profile and game brand. IMAGE 2 is only the approved cream/mint/gold modal styling reference; remove its entire bot configuration content. IMAGE 3 is the existing open-book icon to use beside the new modal title. Keep that book design rather than introducing a robot here.

Output ONE complete portrait mobile screenshot, ideally 853 × 1844 like image 1. No phone frame, no annotations, no multiple screens. The same lobby is visible behind a dark translucent overlay: preserve the green VIP avatar, exact @minhanh, balance 12.500 followed by the gold K coin on its RIGHT, and sound control. No KEN suffix, no human profile. Muted logo/city show behind the dialog. All menu controls behind the overlay are inactive.

Redesign the foreground as a comfortable rounded cream paper dialog with subtle beige bottom edge and fine navy contour, width about 346 at a 390-wide screen. Center it vertically. Spacious, easy-to-read Nunito-style Vietnamese text, navy headings and muted navy body, not dense small print. Crisp smooth controls/icons over the dim pixel-art landscape. Use the same friendly game surface treatment as image 2.

HEADER: existing blue-and-cream open-book icon, exact title "Hướng dẫn chơi", one circular paper X button in the upper right. A thin mint divider below the header. Do not repeat another large title.

Below the header a SINGLE horizontal four-tab segmented bar with these exact labels, from left to right: "Cơ bản", "Tài sản", "Ô đặc biệt", "Kết thúc". All four fit and remain readable. Cơ bản is SELECTED, with a warm golden inset pill. The others are cream. These are category tabs, not numbered pages. Do not add tabs or arrows.

BODY: three airy stacked illustrated instruction rows/cards. Small pastel icon well on LEFT, title + body LEFT ALIGNED on right. Rounded pale cream cards with a thin beige separator, not heavy borders. Distinct simple glossy game icons matching the family, not emoji. Each card has enough padding and generous line spacing. Exact text:
Card 1, small gold coins illustration (ordinary game coins WITHOUT the K currency symbol):
"Chuẩn bị"
"Mỗi người có 1.500 tr để bắt đầu."
Card 2, two dice illustration:
"Gieo & di chuyển"
"Gieo 2 xúc xắc, đi theo tổng số."
"Qua Xuất phát nhận 160 tr."
Card 3, pair of matching dice with a small curved repeat arrow:
"Gieo đôi"
"Gieo đôi được thêm lượt gieo."
"Đôi 3 lần liên tiếp: vào tù."

Under those cards, a compact pale-blue info strip with a small clock icon and exact text "Mỗi hành động có 30 giây." It must say hành động, NOT lượt. Keep all three cards and this strip visible with no cut-off text.

FOOTER: one wide gold pill button "Đã hiểu", centered and fixed to the dialog bottom, with a thin beige divider/gap above. This closes the guide; do not add a play button, cancel, next, or skip. Gold button has warm orange bottom edge and a small upper-left white highlight, not two bright end blobs. Keep footer well inside the panel and comfortable spacing.

The emphasis is a fresh readable quick guide with category navigation, concise illustrated lessons and an obvious close action. No notebook rings, parchment scroll, wooden frame, giant mascots, 3D perspective, glass effect, trophies, bot list, robot, bot count, money wager, version label, watermark, fake browser chrome, or extra invented wording. Preserve all Vietnamese diacritics and correct numerical rules. Do not fit all ten rules on one page; other categories are reached by the four tabs.

runtimeExport: Cắt theo alpha > 8 (alpha.boundsThreshold8), Lanczos về 88 px (win-groups/line/airports 120 px) cạnh dài, đệm trong suốt 4 px, cwebp -q 80 -alpha_q 90 -m 6.
